case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for the openness in explaining your costs. We value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both.

Two points need to be set straight first:

Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

With this in mind, we have prepared options in the spirit of partnership. Longer payment terms are the trade-off for the lower unit prices, and each option gives you a clear start date for the new price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 123.18; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 125.46; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.

We hope one of these works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Building on your third option, we accept the effective date of 2027-04-01 and the 30-day payment terms you requested. In response to your verified data, we concede to a revised price of EUR 135.50 per unit. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This proposal remains valid for 30 days. Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. It is always a pleasure working together with your respected house, and we appreciate the continued partnership between our companies.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your reply and for taking our points on board so constructively. We value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies, and we have not forgotten your support in difficult times.

Our data shows a different picture on the price itself:

Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

German labour costs in manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

In the spirit of partnership, we would like to propose a fair solution for both companies:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 127.97; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 124.23; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 126.53; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.

Option A and Option B give you a longer payment term in exchange for a different price. Option C keeps the payment term you asked for. We would be glad to find the right solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
